items.title: Luther Burden: Stays busy in Week 8 win
items.text:
Burden secured seven of nine targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

items.title: Colston Loveland: Co-team-high catch total in win
items.text:
Loveland secured seven of nine targets for 65 yards and lost a fumble in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

items.title: D'Andre Swift: Three-TD night in win
items.text:
Swift rushed 27 times for 69 yards and three touchdowns and brought in two of three targets for 10 yards in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: Another 100-yard effort in loss
items.text:
